title: A compactly supported C¹ diffeomorphism of ℝ^P is bi-Lipschitz and preserves every set containing its support
statement: Let P ∈ ℕ, E := ℝ^P, U, K ⊆ E with K compact and K ⊆ U, and let φ : E → E be a C¹ bijection such that Dφ(x) is injective for every x ∈ E and φ(x) = x for every x ∉ K. Then there is Λ ≥ 0 such that φ is Λ-Lipschitz, φ is Λ-antilipschitz (|x − y| ≤ Λ|φ(x) − φ(y)| for all x, y), and φ^{-1}(U) = U.
lean_statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (U K : Set (Euclid P)) (φ : Euclid P → Euclid P), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → ContDiff ℝ 1 φ → Bijective φ → (∀ x, Injective (fderiv ℝ φ x)) → (∀ x, x ∉ K → φ x = x) → ∃ Λ : NNReal, LipschitzWith Λ φ ∧ AntilipschitzWith Λ φ ∧ φ ⁻¹' U = U
